capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Language analysis is available in virtual workspaces. Installed-binary validation and some filesystem metadata checks are unavailable.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Internal parsing remains available. Installed-binary validation is disabled and executable settings are not read.
command.validateExternal: Validate Current File with Installed Logrotate
configuration.validation.enable: Enable built-in syntax and semantic diagnostics.
configuration.validation.maxProblems: Maximum number of built-in diagnostics reported for one document.
configuration.targetVersion: Logrotate grammar version used by built-in analysis. Auto uses the installed binary only when host validation is available.
configuration.externalValidation.mode: Run the installed logrotate binary only after saving a trusted local file. Disabled by default.
configuration.executablePath: Executable used for explicitly enabled host validation. This restricted setting is ignored in untrusted workspaces.
configuration.trace.server: Language Server Protocol trace detail. Default info logs omit document content; explicit protocol traces can include it.
